costs.basis: Owner's online staff preferential rate, per side: US 0.06%, min USD 15. Same schedule for SG (0.06%, min SGD 0) and HK (0.06%, min HKD 80); this USD portfolio trades US listings only, so the US row applies.

execution.note: A decision made on session D's close fills at the open of the next NYSE session after D, plus half-spread and square-root impact (ai-hedge-fund TradingCosts), plus commission (0.06% of value, minimum USD 15, on every buy and every sell).

decision_policy.rules: BUY needs Merlin BULLISH with conviction >= min_conviction and a Quant verdict of AGREE or PARTIALLY_AGREE and a Quant stance that is not BEARISH. DISAGREE never adds exposure; with an existing position it REDUCEs to the partial weight when Quant is BEARISH. INCONCLUSIVE or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE gives NO_ACTION.
